articles.title: Pakistan: Business community calls for review of PDL, daily petroleum pricing
articles.titleEn: Pakistan: Business community calls for review of PDL, daily petroleum pricing
articles.summary: Korangi Association of Trade and Industry (KATI) President Muhammad Ikram Rajput said repeated fuel price increases were creating serious difficulties for businesses and adding to economic uncertainty. He said petrol and diesel prices had risen by around Rs22 and Rs14 respectively over three days, placing an additional burden on consumers already facing inflationary pressures, as reported by Dawn.
articles.summaryEn: Korangi Association of Trade and Industry (KATI) President Muhammad Ikram Rajput said repeated fuel price increases were creating serious difficulties for businesses and adding to economic uncertainty. He said petrol and diesel prices had risen by around Rs22 and Rs14 respectively over three days, placing an additional burden on consumers already facing inflationary pressures, as reported by Dawn.
